newsitem.title: USA: Claire's Stores July same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Claire's Stores July same-store sales up.

text.p: Claire's Stores Inc Thursday said sales for the four weeks ended August 2 were $38,034,000, up 17 percent from the year ago's $32,377,000. Same store sales rose nine percent.
For the second quarter of fiscal 1998, ended August 2, the company reported sales of $116,460,000, compared with $100,720,000 a year ago. Same store sales were up seven percent for the quarter.

Claire's Stores is a retailer specializing in one-stop shopping for teens' fashion accessories and currently owns and operates more than 1,600 stores in 49 states, the Caribbean, Canada, Japan and the United Kingdom.
